blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Global Explorers (PGE), a Filipino nonprofit travel organization, has won the Societal Development Award at A World for Travel (AWFT) 2026 in Paris, France, for its contributions to education, environmental protection and community development. PGE Chairman Dr. Riza Rasco accepted the award on behalf of the organization during the AWFT Influence Dinner and Awards Ceremony on Oct. 29 at La Samaritaine. The award recognizes initiatives that use tourism to strengthen communities by creating opportunities, developing skills, promoting inclusion and keeping more value within destinations.
